QUOTE: With the grammars absent, `compiled_languages()` returns an empty set and logs an ERROR. A missing optional grammar makes `_ts_language_for` return None instead of raising... The not-indexed report is meant to name the uncovered file types, so an empty answer doesn't read as "nothing there".
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says missing grammars degrade (no symbols, no raise, deliberately non-breaking) and that the not-indexed report is meant to name uncovered types. It doesn't name the router's capability gate, but the degrade-not-fail substance and the not-indexed reporting are both stated.
